title: First animation
description: A box animated on a timeline: the project the First animation tutorial builds. Play it, then make your copy and change the keyframes.

title: First interaction
description: A button that slides a box, with an On pointer event and an action in the interaction graph: the First interaction tutorial's project.

title: Lamp
description: A bulb switched by a button through a boolean variable, with a tap counter in the text and a binding that follows the variable.

title: Canvas tour
description: Two artboards with a sun, a title and pictures: something to pan, zoom, select and rearrange while you learn the canvas and the Layers panel.

title: Blends
description: A ball that mixes between two poses as you drag a slider: a 1D blend of two timelines.

title: Joysticks
description: Two joysticks. Eyes that follow the pointer (two timelines, left-right and up-down, scrubbed from where the pointer is), and a draggable knob that scrubs a sunrise timeline as the joystick's handle.

title: Grid and stack layouts
description: A gallery of tiles laid out as a grid, and a badge stack, with alignment, gaps and spans.

title: Layout item
description: A toolbar and cards where each child sizes itself differently: fixed, hug, fill, percent, grow and aspect ratio.

title: Line gap
description: A wrapping row of cards, to see how the gap between rows and between items is set.

title: Paint order
description: One shape with a fill and two strokes, drawn in different orders.

title: Layers and web controls
description: A card with a headline, a button, a name field, a link, a video and an embed, shapes and paths, driven by three variables and a few interactions.

title: Script, shader and bones
description: A box painted by JavaScript every frame, a box painted by a GPU shader, wavy text, and a two-bone chain moving a picture.

title: Dusk poster
description: A vector poster brought in from a VectorCraft file: gradients and paths, with its twenty stars drawn by one repeated layer.

title: Little house
description: A line drawing of a house, from a VectorCraft file: walls, roof and a sun in groups.

title: Breathing for calm (imported from Rive)
description: A guided breathing exercise imported from a Rive file: a splash screen, choices, progress bubbles and an end screen, with its states and transitions mapped onto timelines and the interaction graph.

title: Text patterns
description: Text with regular expressions in its {} slots: a phone number found in a sentence, a date reformatted, and a pattern that is refused because it could take forever.

title: Bones and IK
description: A three-bone arm with a skinned shape, a draggable orange dot the tip chases (IK), and a Wave timeline on a button. The project the Try bones in two minutes steps build.

title: Matching question
description: Drag each country onto its capital city: a ready-made matching question with scoring, a hint and feedback. Play it, then make your copy and change the pairs.

title: Hotspot question
description: Click the roof of the house: a ready-made hotspot question with a picture, four areas, scoring, a hint and feedback. Play it, then make your copy and change the picture and the right area.

title: Accordion from data
description: Four sections drawn by one repeated section over a list, each opening while the rest move down, one open at a time: the Accordion tutorial's project.

title: Image slider (carousel)
description: Four slides drawn from a list by one number, with Previous, Next, a dot for each slide, the arrow keys and an autoplay that pauses: the carousel tutorial's project.

title: Before and after compare
description: Two stacked pictures with a divider handle you drag, or move with the keyboard, to show more of one or the other: the Before and after tutorial's project.

title: Mind map and flowchart from data
description: A mind map whose branches fold on a click, and a flowchart you follow one answer at a time, each drawn from lists by one repeated box and one repeated line: the diagrams tutorial's project.

title: Flip cards from a list
description: Six term and meaning cards drawn by one repeated card over a list, each turned over by a click or Enter: the Flip cards tutorial's project.

title: Multiple choice question
description: One multiple choice question with two tries, a hint, feedback for each wrong answer and a result reported when it finishes: the Multiple choice tutorial's project.

title: Course presentation
description: Four slides on one page master with a title slot, a check your understanding question, and Back, Next and the page number added by Page navigation with a slide transition: the presentation tutorial's project.

title: Click to reveal: image hotspots
description: A picture with three numbered points that each open a dialog, closed by a button or Esc, and turn green once visited: the Click to reveal tutorial's project.
